notes: Teaching language for this programme could not be confirmed from the provided pages. The programme page at https://www.hu.nl/voltijd-opleidingen/hbo-ict is Dutch-taught in overall navigation, but there is no explicit statement confirming the language of instruction for this specific programme. Similarly, the exact tuition fee for non-EU students is unclear; the institution page https://www.hu.nl/collegegeld-en-betalen states 'instellingscollegegeld' for students without a residence permit, but does not specify the amount for this specific programme, and the institution-wide figure (€10,747) may not apply. Therefore, tuition is omitted. Application deadlines for non-EU students are given on https://www.minor.hu.nl/ (31 May for non-EU students living outside the Netherlands), but since the programme is listed in Dutch as 'hbo ICT' and the programme page does not specify a deadline, we did not include a formal intake fact. The deadline 31 May is for non-EU students with immigration/visa services, which likely applies to a Moroccan applicant, but we omitted it because the programme page does not mention it explicitly. Document requirements are taken from https://www.minor.hu.nl/ because they are described for 'foreign diploma' applicants generally, which applies to a Moroccan student. However, since the programme page is in Dutch and the document list is from a general bachelor admissions page, this may be a caveat. The language requirement is not stated on the provided pages for this specific programme. The requirement 'secondary school diploma at sufficient level' is stated on https://www.minor.hu.nl/ but since it is a general requirement for English-taught bachelor programmes, and this programme may be Dutch-taught, we did not include it as a formal requirement. Note: The programme page indicates 'Aanmelddeadline t/m 1 mei en 31 januari' which are for Dutch/EU students and for February start, respectively, but for non-EU students the deadlines on https://www.minor.hu.nl/ apply (31 May for September start). The programme page does not explicitly state these international deadlines.
